item.title: Boss Energy Targets New Well-Field Design to Optimise Honeymoon Operations after Strategic Review
item.description: A strategic review of Boss Energy’s (ASX: BOE) Honeymoon uranium project in South Australia has indicated an expected material deviation from the assumptions underpinning a 2021 enhanced feasibility study.

item.title: TrivarX Reports Strong US Veteran Trial Results Supporting Objective Depression Screening
item.description: TrivarX (ASX: TRI) has delivered positive results from a US-based clinical trial that demonstrate clinically meaningful, objective detection of current major depressive episodes in veterans using the company’s single-lead electrocardiogram technology.

item.title: American West Metals Identifies Critical Minerals Upside with West Desert Re-Sampling
item.description: American West Metals (ASX: AW1) has identified significant indium and gallium potential in re-sampling of historical results from its West Desert project in Utah, with the ongoing program unveiling numerous targets for the company to drill-test in 2026.

item.title: EPX Raises $2.14m to Fund Acquisition of WattWatchers Energy Efficiency Platform
item.description: Building energy management solutions company EPX (ASX: EPX) has satisfied all the conditions required to acquire Australian energy efficiency platform WattWatchers, which was recently placed into voluntary administration.

item.title: RocketBoots to Supply AI-Driven Loss Prevention Platform to Retail Giant’s Global Network
item.description: RocketBoots (ASX: ROC) has secured a multi-million agreement with a Tier 1 multi-national retailer to deploy its AI-driven loss prevention platform across approximately 40% of the customer’s global store network.

item.title: Alligator Energy Advances Samphire Pilot Plant Into Commissioning and Field Recovery Trials
item.description: Alligator Energy (ASX: AGE) has achieved practical completion of construction at its Samphire uranium project pilot plant, clearing the way for final commissioning and the commencement of field recovery trials in early 2026.

item.title: Kalgoorlie Gold Mining Extends Primary Gold Mineralisation with RC Drilling At Lighthorse Prospect
item.description: Kalgoorlie Gold Mining (ASX: KAL) has reported strong results from its latest reverse circulation drilling program at the Lighthorse prospect, confirming a significant extension of primary gold mineralisation along strike.

item.title: Archer’s Biochip: What Does Silicon Integration Mean?
item.description: For many investors, the word "silicon" calls to mind the computer revolution of the 80s and 90s, but for Archer Materials (ASX: AXE), it represents a potential lifeline for kidney disease patients and a pathway to scalable manufacturing for a medical device.

item.title: Impact Minerals Advances HPA Commercialisation Through Alluminous-C4V Collaboration
item.description: Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT) has moved to accelerate its high purity alumina (HPA) commercialisation strategy, with its 50%-owned associate company Alluminous entering a technology collaboration agreement with US-based battery innovator Charge CCCV.

item.title: Great Northern Minerals to Expand Catalyst Ridge after Strong Antimony Returns from Rock-Chip Sampling
item.description: Great Northern Minerals (ASX: GNM) has reported a significant antimony discovery at its Catalyst Ridge project after surface sampling identified a quartz–stibnite vein extending for up to one kilometre.
